description: An alert for new procurements by object terms and state (UF) (requires the token edm_…). Channel pull (read with list_alert_matches), webhook (a signed https POST with the whsec_… of the owner) or email (only with the account session: it goes to the verified e-mail of the account). Two modes. By `termos`: a space requires all words, `|` accepts any word of the group (`uniforme|fardamento escolar`). By `cnpj`: the company record gives the activities (CNAE), the dictionary (`GET /api/cnaes`) turns each CNAE into a family of terms, and there is one alert for each distinct family, main first, up to `max_familias`; a CNAE outside the dictionary does not become an alert and is listed in `empresa.cnaes` with `familia: null`. The cron checks every 30 minutes. The email channel requires the account session: the notice goes to the verified e-mail of the account, without a confirmation code, and it exists only with `EMAIL_ALERTAS=1`.

destino.description: https URL (webhook); ignored for pull and email (email goes to the account e-mail).

filtros.description: Extra filter: modalities, municipalities, exclusions, values, open proposals and CNAEs. PATCH replaces the whole filter; {} clears it.

termos.description: Object words, 3 to 200 letters; a space means all, | means any (uniforme|fardamento).
